learner_operation: Determine the variables on which the RHS depends; inspect constancy or variation of segment slopes along fixed-x and fixed-y lines; select the unique field satisfying (or violating) the specified dependence. Explicit-equation questions must also depict that equation rather than merely an arbitrary two-variable field.

fixed_features.feature: One uniquely qualifying image in each radio bank
fixed_features.justification: Single radio answer, as in all captured practice fields; uniqueness is essential, position and shape are not.

fixed_features.feature: Moderate explicit RHS depends on both x and y
fixed_features.justification: The target tutorial 17592186172978 and all three complete moderate sources assess the contrast with one-variable dependence. The only-both rule is explicitly taught, so it is not an incidental shortcut.

fixed_features.feature: Could in moderate, cannot in hard
fixed_features.justification: Matches the observed difficulty split; source q-96477 is unrated and its hard assignment is explicitly authored.
